info.title: Rental Fleet API
info.description: Tenant-scoped SaaS Core, Fleet Core and Customer/Rental Core. Bearer token required; optional X-Business-Id selects an active membership. Lists use page/limit; errors include statusCode, code, message and requestId.

rentalAmount.description: Exact database amount; legacy fractional values are not rounded.

versions.description: Latest 100 versions; older versions remain accessible by version.

id.description: Stable derived identity; not a persisted event or authorization credential.

ageSeconds.description: Elapsed seconds since dueAt or lastSeenAt. Zero for returns that are not yet due; use dueAt and asOf for remaining time.

asOf.description: Database time shared by calculations, counts and page rows.

stats.description: Counts respect vehicle/rental filters, before kind/severity filters.

amount.description: Positive whole VND string. REVERSAL has the opposite effect to its original movement.

basis.description: Recorded rental payments and miscellaneous income plus noncash deposit retention; excludes contracted/projected amounts.

recordedRevenue.description: Whole VND string: recorded payments, miscellaneous income and deposit retention, net of corrections.

cashReceived.description: Whole VND string: rental payments plus miscellaneous income; excludes deposits and noncash retention.

estimatedProfit.description: Recorded revenue minus recorded operating expenses. Estimate, excludes unrecorded costs.

netOperatingCashFlow.description: Cash received minus operating expenses; deposit movements excluded.

depositHeld.description: Cumulative deposit receipts minus refunds and retained amounts before until, ignoring from.

amount.description: Exact whole VND, positive integer string, maximum 999999999999999.

occurredAt.description: Explicit UTC offset; cannot be later than database time.

rentalId.description: Required for rental payments and deposit movements. Derives vehicleId.

reason.description: Correction reason; saved in reversal notes, never audit metadata.

contractedAmount.description: Rental Core amount rounded to whole VND half up; never counted as recorded receipt.

depositRequired.description: Required deposit rounded to whole VND half up; historical depositReceived boolean is not a payment.

memberships.description: Tenant membership rows, not unique people across businesses.

activeMemberships.description: ACTIVE membership rows whose profile is ACTIVE; includes disabled businesses.

totals.description: Counts across all businesses, including disabled ones.

activeMembershipCount.description: Membership, business and profile must all be ACTIVE.

data.description: One row per unique profile, never one row per membership.

accessUrl.description: Credential, shown once. Never persist or log this URL.
Credential, shown once. Never persist or log this URL.

address.description: Identification numbers are masked on list responses.

driverLicenseClass.description: Identification numbers are masked on list responses.

phone.description: At least one of phone or email is required.

address.description: Full value on detail; identification numbers are masked in list responses.

driverLicenseNumber.description: Full value on detail; identification numbers are masked in list responses.

driverLicenseClass.description: Full value on detail; identification numbers are masked in list responses.

expectedQuoteHash.description: Required for a calculated or overridden available quotation; current rate/schedule must match.

overrideAmount.description: Explicit agreed whole-VND amount; requires a reason.

overrideReason.description: Required for a manual agreement or override.

startAt.description: ISO date-time with explicit UTC offset.

fuelPercent.description: Fuel level as an integer percentage, 0 through 100.

damageNotes.description: Required and nonblank when exteriorCondition or interiorCondition is DAMAGED.

notes.description: Optional replacement notes, recorded on the rental rather than audit metadata.

deletionEnabled.description: False by default. Physical deletion requires an explicit development-only server switch.
False by default. Physical deletion requires an explicit development-only server switch.

totalReservedBytes.description: Quota reservations including temporary pending copies; not a project-wide Storage bill.

pending.description: Unattached upload reservations: bytes are reserved worst-case capacity.

purged.description: Immutable removed-media metadata, showing original bytes.

unresolvedDispute.description: Must be explicitly false when releasing the hold; unresolved disputes remain protected.

positions.description: Persisted unique fixes received in the last 15 minutes, excluding retransmissions.

lastRecordedAt.description: Latest recorded fix among positions received in this window.

limiterScope.description: Limits apply independently to each API process and reset on restart.

failureReporting.description: Failure counts are process-wide, redacted and never exposed across tenant boundaries.

basis.description: Temporal overlap with a scheduled rental; does not prove actual customer use.

id.description: Opaque query-scoped derived identifier, not an authorization credential. Late packets or retention may change segmentation.

rentalId.description: Set only for exactly one containing scheduled rental; association remains inferred.

distanceMeters.description: Haversine estimate over usable consecutive fixes; never an odometer measurement.

retentionBoundaryAt.description: Received-time retention cutoff; older retained latest fixes do not imply complete history.

breakBefore.description: Start a new polyline here; never connect a physically implausible jump.

vehicleId.description: Null uses the business default scope.

extraHourRate.description: Daily remainder is charged in commenced hours, capped at one daily rate.

effectiveFrom.description: Inclusive pickup-time eligibility, with explicit offset.

effectiveUntil.description: Exclusive upper bound; null has no scheduled end.

vehicleId.description: Null uses the business default scope.

extraHourRate.description: Daily remainder is charged in commenced hours, capped at one daily rate.

effectiveFrom.description: Inclusive pickup-time eligibility, with explicit offset.

effectiveUntil.description: Exclusive upper bound; null has no scheduled end.

billingMode.description: Defaults to daily when available, otherwise hourly.

quoteHash.description: Fingerprint of the selected schedule/rate state, including a missing-rate preview.

rentedHours.description: Rented hours inside the report window.

utilizationPercent.description: Scheduled/actual rented time divided by window, 0–100.

vehicles.description: Up to 50 active vehicles ordered by revenue then utilization.
